switchMod.title: The $1 Toggle Switch Mod
switchMod.description: Porsche 986/996 wired body & chassis modules to OBD Pin 3 instead of standard Pin 7. By installing an SPDT slide or toggle switch inside the transparent blue OBD connector shell, you can toggle the FTDI RX/TX between Pin 7 (Engine/Cluster) and Pin 3 (ABS/Alarm/Airbag/Top) with zero external boxes.

buyTips: Ensure the listing explicitly specifies genuine FTDI (FT232RL or FT232RQ), NOT cheap CH340 or Prolific clone chips.
Search terms: 'VAG KKL 409.1 FTDI FT232RL USB OBD2'.
Set USB serial COM port Latency Timer to 1ms (or let peeweesys-helper auto-configure it).

name: Tactrix OpenPort 2.0 (J2534)
summary: Professional-grade J2534 PassThru hardware supporting high-speed ISO 15765 CAN Bus, ISO 9141, and software pin routing.
buyTips: Tactrix OpenPort natively switches multiplexed pins in software, eliminating physical switch mods.
Ideal for CAN probing, 987/997 ECU diagnostics, and UDS multi-frame ISO-TP messaging.
High reliability and clean hardware timing.

name: OBDLink EX / SX USB
summary: Fast STN-chip based USB adapter supporting full CAN bus messaging and high baud rates up to 2Mbps without packet loss.
buyTips: Select the OBDLink EX (USB cable version engineered for FORScan/high data throughput) or SX.
Direct FTDI-compatible virtual serial port with native buffer management.
